column1: # Activation manifest — declarative source of truth for which feature
# flags gate which scripts in this skill, and what env keys (if any)
# each one needs.  `scripts/status.sh` parses this file to print a
# one-screen dashboard.  The auditor verifies (B3) that every flag
# named here is actually checked inside the referenced script.
#   2. relative path of the gated script
#   3. comma-separated list of env vars the script additionally needs
#      when the flag is ON; empty (use `-`) means no extra env needed
# Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
# Categories are derived from the path prefix:
# When a new flag is added to a script, append a row here so the
# Below two sources are permanent-mock by design (see SKILL.md status table);
# flags still exist as orchestration hooks but enabling them does NOT
# unlock live mode.  Declared here so the dashboard is complete.
